causes.label: demand
causes.quote: On the day, maximum temperatures reached 41 degrees in Melbourne and 48 degrees in Adelaide (a new record temperature), leading to high demand for electricity in both regions.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Total semi-scheduled wind generation across Victoria and South Australia was between 39 MW and 331 MW lower than forecast four hours ahead.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Energy Australia advised AEMO that it would be taking its 355 MW Yallourn unit 4 out of service for planned maintenance from 19 January for a period of seven days.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: AGL's Loy Yang A unit 3 experienced a tube leak removing a further 530 MW of potential available capacity in Victoria from the afternoon of 22 January to 26 January.
